boundsPortedFromTheOracle.order: src/game-loop.js updateDiving(): depth after physics -> ascentRate = -(depth - prevDepth)/dtDiveMinutes -> updateTissues -> frameCalc.ceiling/ndl -> gas use -> DCS/barotrauma timers -> 'Issue #44' capture -> minNdlSeen, ndlDroppedBelow5 -> dive-ending checks. The model evaluates the ceiling and NDL right after advanceTissues and updates the log after the gas use and bailout, before updateFailureState.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.constants: FAST_ASCENT_RATE 9 m/min, FAST_ASCENT_EVENT_SEC 2, CEILING_VIOLATION_TOL_M 0.3, CEILING_VIOLATION_EVENT_SEC 2 (src/constants.js:125-128); NDL tracked while depth > 0.5; ndlDroppedBelow5 when NDL < 5.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.latches: Legacy sets the accumulator to -Infinity after an entry and resets it when the condition lapses; the log keeps fastAscentLatched / ceilingViolationLatched instead, which a JSON save can hold.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.gas: calculateNDL(): CCR and not bailed out -> getCCRInspiredGas(depth, targetSP); otherwise activeGas(). decompressionGas() in src/core/dive-model.ts, now also the planner's forecast gas.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.notCompared: The scripted scenarios set the depth before each tick (scripts/baseline-scenarios.cjs updateAtDepth), so legacy's ascentRate there is measured against the target (about 8.8 m/min on the air ascent); a replay of their trajectories would log fast ascents legacy never recorded. Entries are compared on the two buoyancy scenarios only.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.failureOrder: updateCCR() detects CCR hypoxia, hyperoxia and CO2 and returns from updateDiving() before the 'Issue #44' capture; out of gas, O2 toxicity, OC hypoxia and the others are checked after it. ascentRate is computed with the physics, before either. The model settles the failure first, skips the log for the three rebreather reasons (moving only the ascent rate), and logs otherwise.

parity.continuation: At every checkpoint of both buoyancy scenarios and the three bottoms: ascent rate (1e-9), lowest NDL (exact), each window's latch (null in the fixture) and, when not latched, its length (1e-9), and the fast-ascent peak (1e-9).
